stage: Design fixed before gradients; full label data and HF training source still required
purpose: Separate the effect of broader balanced data from richer public-state representation; test fixed seed-ensemble disagreement handling against the previous overconfidence failure.

frozen.description: Control: frozen ordered-player context384 plus66 public suffix features; frozen action128 plus raw action100.

public.description: Frozen context384 plus all1215 raw public state features through a new256/128 encoder; frozen action128 plus raw action100. Direct access can recover information lost by the parent embeddings.

ensemble_rule: Four equally weighted independently initialized seed heads. Subtract each head parent utility before aggregating. Compare mean advantage and mean minus one population standard deviation. Disagreement is not a calibrated confidence interval; no threshold fitting.
development_candidates: Exactly four ensembles: both representations, each with penalties0 and1. All four seed checkpoints participate, no best-seed cherry-picking. Individual seeds are diagnostics only.
scope: Multi-choice nomination, bidding and building only. Fixed six-proposal geographic/economic teacher shortlist plus frozen parent fallback. Other phases and value outputs remain frozen this iteration; this does not restrict the broader strength goal.
continuation_mixture: Equal neural and neural_economic, per sampled world before estimating uncertainty. Concatenate independent96-world A/B batches into192 paired samples. Keep every adverse or uncertain target.
loss: Subtract predicted utility of the exact teacher parent proposal. MSE against the mean paired action advantage, no hard winner labels. Normalize uncertainty weights inside each root, then average roots equally.
validation_selection: Each seed: epoch0 plus every fifth epoch; smallest mean validation simulated regret, ties keep earlier epoch. Whole-deal validation split is fixed. No validation gradients or margin tuning.
calibration: Report predicted versus measured paired gain, root-normalized RMSE, negative changes and separate A/B outcomes globally and by count/rules/decision. These diagnostics do not qualify a model.
export: Unchanged stored float32 weights with float64-exp-div-silu-v1 arithmetic. Strict native/ONNX/legal checks on2553 full-menu fixtures and17280 cached positions, frozen values/out-of-scope actions and parent fallback preserved.
acceptance: Fresh whole-game held-out comparisons with parent and independent strong baselines across2–6players and allfour rules; retain every adverse cell. Parent itself is unqualified, so merely preserving it is insufficient. Actual8840U benchmark of the exact candidate and untouched reserved final gate remain mandatory.
